rakia_debug.description: Enable full debug output when set to true. Corresponds to setting RAKIA_DEBUG=all.

rakia_logfile.description: Filename to overwrite with log messages. Can be prefixed with '+' to append. Corresponds to RAKIA_LOGFILE.

rakia_persist.description: If true, sets RAKIA_PERSIST to prevent telepathy-rakia from exiting when idle.

tport_log.description: If true, sets TPORT_LOG to print all parsed SIP messages at the transport layer.
